newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan August aluminium output, shipments up yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan August aluminium output, shipments up yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's output and shipments of aluminium mill products rose in August from the same month last year, but on a month-over-month basis they were off from July's record highs, the Japan Aluminium Federation said on Thursday.
Total August output of extruded and flat-rolled products was up 10.9 percent year-on-year at 198,351 tonnes, while shipments rose 7.8 percent to 198,409 tonnes.
On a month-over-month basis, however, August output was off 11.0 percent from July's upwardly revised 222,960 tonnes and shipments fell 11.7 percent from a revised 224,744 tonnes.
August output of flat-rolled products, led by strong demand for beverage can sheet, rose 11.9 percent year-on-year to 100,513 tonnes, while shipments were up 6.4 percent at 99,934.
Output of extruded products increased 10.0 percent year-on-year to 97,838 tonnes, while shipments were up 9.3 percent at 98,475 tonnes.

Strong demand from the housing sector, as consumers rushed to make purchases ahead of next April's scheduled hike in Japan's consumption tax, continued to fuel strong demand for aluminium window sashes, the federation said.
August foil output was off 4.0 percent year-on-year at 9,926 tonnes, although shipments rose for the first time this year, edging up 0.6 percent to 10,417 tonnes.

The federation also noted a turnaround in aluminium shipments to the automobile sector, which in July jumped 14.6 percent year-on-year to 16,748 tonnes, the first increase in more than a year. No sector-specific data was yet available for August.
